principle: A failed hard-gate cannot be offset by a high score on other dimensions.

gates.fail_if: required certificate missing, expired, suspended, or out of scope
legal entity / factory / SKU / batch identity unresolved
positive prohibited analyte or contested lab packet used as HALAL
seal break or seal-id mismatch without human close-out
unexplained custody gap on the corridor

eligible_state_space: all hard-gates passed or explicitly waived by competent authority (E5)
score_function: descriptive aggregate only after eligible_state_space == true
